<explanation>
Based on the provided file tree and README, I'll explain how to create a comprehensive system design diagram for Quarkdown, which is a modern Markdown-based typesetting system with scripting capabilities.

1. Main Components Identification:

The system can be broken down into these major components:

a) Core Engine:
- Lexer/Parser (core/src/main/kotlin/eu/iamgio/quarkdown/lexer, parser)
- AST (core/src/main/kotlin/eu/iamgio/quarkdown/ast)
- Function System (core/src/main/kotlin/eu/iamgio/quarkdown/function)
- Rendering System (core/src/main/kotlin/eu/iamgio/quarkdown/rendering)

b) CLI Interface:
- Command Processing (cli/src/main/kotlin/eu/iamgio/quarkdown/cli)
- Execution Strategies (cli/src/main/kotlin/eu/iamgio/quarkdown/cli/exec/strategy)

c) Server Component:
- Web Server (server/src/main/kotlin/eu/iamgio/quarkdown/server)
- Browser Integration (server/src/main/kotlin/eu/iamgio/quarkdown/server/browser)

d) Standard Library:
- Built-in Functions (stdlib/src/main/kotlin/eu/iamgio/quarkdown/stdlib)

3. Color Coding:

- Blue: User Interface components
- Green: Processing components
- Yellow: Core Engine components
- Purple: Library components
- Red: Data flow arrows

4. Key Relationships to Highlight:

a) Input Flow:
- CLI/REPL → Pipeline → Core Engine
- Web Interface → Web Server → Pipeline

b) Processing Flow:
- Lexer → Parser → AST → Functions → Renderer
- Standard Library integration with Functions
- Pipeline orchestration of the entire process

5. Additional Elements:

Include these important aspects:
- Document type support (slides, paged, plain)
- Media storage system
- Theme system
- File watching and live preview capabilities
- Function call system
- Error handling flow

6. Annotations:

Add notes explaining:
- Supported output formats (HTML, PDF)
- Required external dependencies (Java 17+)
- Integration points for custom libraries
- Configuration options

The diagram should emphasize Quarkdown's unique features:
- Function-based extension system
- Multiple document type support
- Live preview capabilities
- Theme system
